title: [Suite autour de Teichmüller dont] Teichmülleries, 1981-1982 : notes manuscrites (1981-1983, s.d.), lettres (1981, s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
Setting (continued from the previous page). P is a regular n-gon with vertex set S and edge set A. Σ = Σ_P is the Riemann sphere carrying the 'cyclotomic map' (carte cyclotomique): the n vertices R_s are the n-th roots of unity on a great circle Σ_R, which is the canonical real structure. The edge midpoints are Q_a. The two open hemispheres are the two faces, and they correspond to the two orientations ω, ω' = ω^{-1}. The poles P_ω and P_ω' are the two fixed points of the rotation group.

On this page:
(51) Grothendieck sets Σ_P^* = Σ_P \ S_P, the sphere minus the n vertices. He defines π_{P,ω} = π_1(Σ_P^*, P_ω), a free group of rank n−1, based at the face-centre P_ω attached to the chosen orientation ω.
(52) τ is the unique antiholomorphic involution fixing Σ_R pointwise and exchanging P_ω and P_ω'. It is complex conjugation for the canonical real structure. The group D_P × {1,τ}, of order 4n, is the full automorphism group of the cyclotomic map, holomorphic and antiholomorphic together. D_P is the holomorphic dihedral group of order 2n: rotations by 2π/n about the poles, plus half-turns about the axes through the R_s and Q_a. It maps isomorphically onto Aut(P), and it is the orientation-preserving subgroup. {1,τ} is the kernel of the action on Σ_R, equivalently on P.
(53) He introduces 'mixed' fundamental groups (groupoids) for these group actions: π^τ, π^D, π^{D,τ} = π_1(Σ^*, G; P_ω) for G = {1,τ}, D_P, D_P × {1,τ}. In modern terms each is the fundamental group of the quotient orbifold/stack [Σ^*/G]. It sits in an extension 1 → π → π^G → G → 1, whose elements are pairs (g, homotopy class of a path P_ω → g·P_ω). These give the diamond of inclusions (54) on the next page.

Purpose: this is a combinatorial model of the fundamental groupoid of M_{0,n}-type configurations attached to the regular polygon. It keeps track of dihedral symmetry and the real structure (complex conjugation), as building blocks for the 'Teichmüller tower' / Lego programme. On the following page Grothendieck writes generators ρ_s = λ_a λ_{ω'(a)}^{-1} from half-great-circle paths λ_a, with the single cyclic relation ρ_{ω^{n-1}s}⋯ρ_s = 1.
errors: No mathematical error found. Order 4n is correct (|D_P| = 2n). D_P × {1,τ} is a direct product because τ commutes with all the holomorphic symmetries of the cyclotomic map: it commutes with the rotations about the poles up to the obvious identification, and with the half-turns.

Minor: the condition characterizing D_P is ambiguous in the manuscript ('qui induit l'identité sur S' cannot be right for D_P). It should read: orientation-preserving, or equivalently acting faithfully on S. The 'identity on S/P' condition characterizes {1,τ}.

missed.claim: Grothendieck systematically incorporates complex conjugation τ alongside the dihedral group into the fundamental groupoid of the basic genus-0 building block. This gives an explicit Gal(C/R)-extension π^τ, based at a non-real point, as part of the Teichmüller-tower machinery. This anticipates a real/dihedral refinement of the genus-0 tower: dihedral structures on M_{0,n} (F. Brown) and real sections / real section conjecture questions (Pál, Wickelgren). The manuscript does not develop this beyond definitions here.
missed.quote: On va aussi regarder les groupoïdes fondamentaux mixtes de Σ*, pour l'action sur Σ* de {1,τ}, de D_P, ou de D_P × {1,τ}
missed.why_it_might_matter_today: Modest: it is a natural set-up, but an explicit dihedral+real equivariant combinatorial model of the tower could interest those working on real points of M_{0,n} and on GT-type actions twisted by complex conjugation.

deep.surprise_reason: Careful but standard set-up: free fundamental group of the punctured sphere, symmetry group of the regular cyclotomic map, and orbifold-type extensions. Its interest lies only in being part of Grothendieck's unpublished detailed Teichmüller-tower notes including the real structure.
transcription_corrections: Equation labels are (51), (52), (53), continuing (50) from the previous page and leading into (54) on the next; they are not 'S1, S2, S3'.
'Les posons' is the struck-through 'Les groupes fond...' replaced by 'Posons' / 'On pose'.
'correspondant au choix de ω, que [je note/pose]': the line ends 'que' with 'pose' on the next line.
In the D_P characterization, the second condition is probably 'qui induit [une permutation dihédrale/l'orientation] sur S', not 'l'identité sur S'. 'l'identité ... (ou sur P)' belongs to {1,τ}.
Figure caption reads '(s,a) = r d'orientation ω'. The label read as 'J_ω' near the right of the figure is uncertain.
